_comment: Host-specific settings that `aah install` merges into the host settings file (e.g. .claude/settings.json). Keyed by platform. Merges reconcile against the `_aah` marker: env keys are only added when absent (a value the user already set is never overwritten); permissions.allow/deny are unioned with these defaults AND any entry aah previously added (recorded under `_aah`) that is no longer listed here is pruned. Entries the user added independently are never touched. NOTE: for Claude, file-permission checks only apply to Edit-family tools (Edit/Write/MultiEdit), NOT to Write() rules — a `Write(<path>)` deny is a dead rule the harness warns about. So secret-file protection is expressed with `Edit(<path>)` (which covers Write) and `Read(<path>)`; do NOT add `Write(<path>)` deny entries.
